-- Every bronze referral row, typed. A referral can appear in several batches as
-- its state changes; int_referrals_checked keeps the latest version.
-- The invited email is replaced by a keyed hash here.
select
    coalesce(cast(try_cast(referral_id as bigint) as varchar),
             'unparsed:' || _source_file || ':' || _row_number) as record_key,
    try_cast(referral_id as bigint)          as referral_id,
    try_cast(referrer_user_id as integer)    as referrer_user_id,
    case when nullif(trim(referred_email), '') is not null then
        sha256('local-dev-salt' || regexp_replace(lower(trim(referred_email)), '\+[^@]*@', '@'))
    end       as referred_email_hash,
    try_cast(referred_user_id as integer)    as referred_user_id,
    nullif(trim(referral_code), '')          as referral_code,
    try_cast(sent_at as timestamp)           as sent_at,
    try_cast(converted_at as timestamp)      as converted_at,
    lower(trim(status))                      as status,
    md5(concat_ws('|',
        coalesce(referral_id, '~'), coalesce(referrer_user_id, '~'), coalesce(referred_email, '~'),
        coalesce(referred_user_id, '~'), coalesce(referral_code, '~'), coalesce(sent_at, '~'),
        coalesce(converted_at, '~'), coalesce(status, '~')
    ))                                       as content_hash,
    _batch_id,
    _row_number,
    _source_file
from "carton_caps"."bronze"."referrals"

    coalesce(cast(purchase_id as varchar), 'unparsed:' || _source_file || ':' || _row_number) as record_key,
    *,
    -- What a client retry would repeat: everything except the id.
    case when user_id is not null and product_id is not null and purchased_at is not null
              and quantity is not null and price_paid is not null

    end as natural_key

    from "carton_caps"."bronze"."users"
    group by user_id
),

typed as (
    select
        try_cast(l.user_id as integer)      as user_id,
        try_cast(l.school_id as integer)    as school_id,
        lower(trim(l.user_type))            as user_type,
        try_cast(l.created_at as timestamp) as signup_at,
        case when nullif(trim(l.email), '') is not null then
        sha256('local-dev-salt' || regexp_replace(lower(trim(l.email)), '\+[^@]*@', '@'))
    end         as email_hash,
        f.first_seen_batch_id,
        l._batch_id                         as snapshot_batch_id
    from latest as l
    left join first_seen as f on f.user_id = l.user_id
),

with_counts as (
    select
        *,
        case when email_hash is not null
             then count(*) over (partition by email_hash) end as users_with_email
    from typed
),

checked as (
    select
        u.*,
        coalesce(u.users_with_email, 1) > 1 as has_shared_email,
        list_filter([
            case when u.user_id is null or u.signup_at is null then 'unparseable_or_missing' end,
            case when s.school_id is null then 'orphan_school' end,
            case when u.user_type is null or u.user_type not in ('parent', 'teacher', 'supporter')
                 then 'invalid_user_type' end,
            case when coalesce(u.users_with_email, 1) > 1 then 'shared_email' end
        ], lambda x: x is not null) as dq_issues
    from with_counts as u
    left join "carton_caps"."silver"."stg_schools" as s on s.school_id = u.school_id
)

    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users"
    where acquisition_channel = 'referral' and email_hash is not null

staged as (
    select
        r.referral_id,
        r.referrer_user_id,
        referrer.school_id                                        as referrer_school_id,
        referrer.user_type                                        as referrer_user_type,
        case when i.invites <= 2 then '1-2 invites'
             when i.invites <= 9 then '3-9 invites'
             else '10+ invites' end                               as referrer_segment,
        r.referred_user_id,
        referred.school_id                                        as referred_school_id,
        r.referred_email_hash,
        r.referral_code,
        r.sent_at,
        cast(date_trunc('month', r.sent_at) as date)              as sent_month,

        r.status = 'converted'                                    as is_converted,
        r.status = 'converted'
            and fp.first_purchase_at <= r.converted_at + to_days(30)
                                                                  as is_qualified,
        -- Converted too recently to know yet whether they will qualify (right-censored).
        r.status = 'converted'
            and r.converted_at + to_days(30)
                <= (select ends_at from data_end)                 as is_qualification_window_complete,
        fp.first_purchase_at                                      as referred_first_purchase_at,
        round(date_diff('second', r.sent_at, r.converted_at) / 3600.0, 2) as hours_to_convert,
        referred.school_id = referrer.school_id                   as is_same_school,
        r.status <> 'converted' and exists (
            select 1 from referral_joiners as j
            where j.email_hash = r.referred_email_hash

    full outer join invites as i
        on i.user_id = p.user_id and i.activity_date = p.activity_date
)

select
    c.user_id,
    u.school_id,
    c.activity_date,
    cast(date_trunc('month', c.activity_date) as date) as activity_month,
    c.purchases,
    c.spend,
    c.points_earned,

    c.referrals_sent
from combined as c
inner join "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users" as u on u.user_id = c.user_id

-- One row per user who sent at least one valid invite: direct results plus the
-- whole downstream network they started (referrals of referrals, and so on).
with recursive

links as (
    select referrer_user_id as parent_id, referred_user_id as child_id
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
    where is_converted
),

descendants (root_id, user_id, depth) as (
    select parent_id, child_id, 1 from links
    union all
    select d.root_id, l.child_id, d.depth + 1
    from descendants as d
    inner join links as l on l.parent_id = d.user_id
    where d.depth < 50
),

network as (
    select root_id as user_id, count(distinct user_id) as network_size, max(depth) as deepest_chain
    from descendants
    group by all
),

network_funds as (
    select d.root_id as user_id, sum(p.dollars_raised) as network_dollars_raised
    from (select distinct root_id, user_id from descendants) as d
    inner join "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_purchases" as p on p.user_id = d.user_id
    group by all
),

direct as (
    select
        referrer_user_id                          as user_id,
        count(*)                                  as invites,
        count(*) filter (where is_clicked)        as clicked,
        count(*) filter (where is_converted)      as direct_referrals,
        count(*) filter (where is_qualified)      as qualified_referrals,
        count(*) filter (where is_converted and is_same_school) as same_school_referrals,
        sum(bonus_usd) / 2                        as bonuses_earned_usd
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
    group by all
)

select
    d.user_id,
    u.school_id,
    u.user_type,
    u.acquisition_channel,
    u.referral_generation,
    d.invites,
    d.clicked,
    d.direct_referrals,
    d.qualified_referrals,
    round(d.direct_referrals / d.invites, 4)       as conversion_rate,
    d.same_school_referrals,
    coalesce(n.network_size, 0)                    as network_size,
    coalesce(n.deepest_chain, 0)                   as deepest_chain,
    coalesce(f.network_dollars_raised, 0)          as network_dollars_raised,
    d.bonuses_earned_usd,
    rank() over (order by coalesce(n.network_size, 0) desc, d.direct_referrals desc, d.invites desc) as network_rank
from direct as d
inner join "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users" as u on u.user_id = d.user_id
left join network as n on n.user_id = d.user_id
left join network_funds as f on f.user_id = d.user_id

-- Referral funnel by the month invites were sent and the referrer's invite volume
-- (plus 'all'): sent -> clicked -> converted -> qualified, bonus cost, and what
-- the referred users went on to raise.
with invites as (
    select *, referrer_segment as segment from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
    union all by name
    select *, 'all' as segment from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
),

referred_user_funds as (
    select user_id, sum(dollars_raised) as dollars_raised
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_purchases"
    group by all
)

select
    i.sent_month,
    i.segment                                                          as referrer_segment,
    count(*)                                                           as invites,
    count(*) filter (where i.is_clicked)                               as clicked,
    count(*) filter (where i.is_converted)                             as converted,
    count(*) filter (where i.is_qualified)                             as qualified,
    round(count(*) filter (where i.is_clicked) / count(*), 4)          as click_rate,
    round(count(*) filter (where i.is_converted) / count(*), 4)        as conversion_rate,
    round(count(*) filter (where i.is_converted)
          / nullif(count(*) filter (where i.is_clicked), 0), 4)        as click_to_conversion_rate,
    count(*) filter (where i.is_converted and not i.is_qualification_window_complete)
                                                                       as converted_still_in_window,
    -- Only conversions whose qualification window has closed, so recent months aren't understated.
    round(count(*) filter (where i.is_qualified and i.is_qualification_window_complete)
          / nullif(count(*) filter (where i.is_qualification_window_complete), 0), 4)
                                                                       as qualification_rate,
    round(median(i.hours_to_convert) filter (where i.is_converted), 2) as median_hours_to_convert,
    sum(i.bonus_usd)                                                   as bonus_cost_usd,
    coalesce(sum(f.dollars_raised) filter (where i.is_converted), 0)   as dollars_raised_by_referred_users,
    round(coalesce(sum(f.dollars_raised) filter (where i.is_converted), 0)
          / nullif(sum(i.bonus_usd), 0), 4)                            as dollars_raised_per_bonus_dollar
from invites as i
left join referred_user_funds as f on f.user_id = i.referred_user_id
group by all

select user_id, activity_date, count(*) as n
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_user_activity_daily"

select * from "carton_caps"."gold"."referrer_leaderboard" where not coalesce((network_size >= direct_referrals), false)

-- The 'all' rows of the funnel must match the referral fact table.
with funnel as (
    select sum(invites) as invites, sum(converted) as converted, sum(qualified) as qualified,
           sum(bonus_cost_usd) as bonus
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."referral_funnel_monthly"
    where referrer_segment = 'all'
),

facts as (
    select count(*) as invites,
           count(*) filter (where is_converted) as converted,
           count(*) filter (where is_qualified) as qualified,
           sum(bonus_usd) as bonus
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
)

select f.*, x.*
from funnel as f, facts as x
where f.invites <> x.invites or f.converted <> x.converted
   or f.qualified <> x.qualified or f.bonus <> x.bonus

-- Monthly signup cohorts: share of each cohort active k months after signup,
-- split by acquisition channel (plus 'all'). Month 0 is the signup month.
-- Only months fully inside the data are included.
with users as (
    select user_id, signup_cohort_month as cohort_month, acquisition_channel as channel
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users"
    union all
    select user_id, signup_cohort_month, 'all'
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users"
),

last_month as (
    select max(month_start) as month from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_date"
),

cohorts as (
    select cohort_month, channel, count(*) as cohort_size
    from users
    group by all
),

offsets as (
    select c.cohort_month, c.channel, c.cohort_size, k.months_since_signup
    from cohorts as c
    cross join range(0, 120) as k(months_since_signup)
    where c.cohort_month + to_months(cast(k.months_since_signup as integer)) <= (select month from last_month)
),

user_months as (
    select user_id, activity_month, sum(points_earned) as points_earned
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_user_activity_daily"
    group by all
),

cohort_activity as (
    select
        u.cohort_month,
        u.channel,
        date_diff('month', u.cohort_month, m.activity_month) as months_since_signup,
        count(distinct u.user_id)                            as active_users,
        sum(m.points_earned)                                 as points_earned
    from users as u
    inner join user_months as m on m.user_id = u.user_id
    group by all
)

select
    o.cohort_month,
    o.channel,
    o.months_since_signup,
    o.cohort_size,
    coalesce(a.active_users, 0)                                   as active_users,
    round(coalesce(a.active_users, 0) / o.cohort_size, 4)         as retention_rate,
    round(cast(round(sum(coalesce(a.points_earned, 0)) over w / 100, 2) as decimal(18, 2)) / o.cohort_size, 4)
                                                                  as cumulative_dollars_raised_per_user
from offsets as o
left join cohort_activity as a
    on a.cohort_month = o.cohort_month
   and a.channel = o.channel
   and a.months_since_signup = o.months_since_signup
window w as (partition by o.cohort_month, o.channel order by o.months_since_signup)

-- Monthly growth from referrals: signups, referral share, invites per active user,
-- and the viral coefficient K = invites per active user x invite conversion rate.
with months as (
    select distinct month_start as month from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_date"
),

active as (
    select activity_month as month, count(distinct user_id) as active_users
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_user_activity_daily"
    group by all
),

signups as (
    select
        signup_cohort_month                                    as month,
        count(*)                                               as signups,
        count(*) filter (where acquisition_channel = 'referral') as referral_signups
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users"
    group by all
),

invites as (
    select
        sent_month                              as month,
        count(*)                                as invites,
        count(*) filter (where is_converted)    as converted_invites
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_referrals"
    group by all
)

select
    m.month,
    coalesce(a.active_users, 0)                                              as active_users,
    coalesce(s.signups, 0)                                                   as signups,
    coalesce(s.referral_signups, 0)                                          as referral_signups,
    round(coalesce(s.referral_signups, 0) / nullif(s.signups, 0), 4)         as referral_share_of_signups,
    coalesce(i.invites, 0)                                                   as invites,
    round(coalesce(i.invites, 0) / nullif(a.active_users, 0), 4)             as invites_per_active_user,
    round(i.converted_invites / nullif(i.invites, 0), 4)                     as invite_conversion_rate,
    round(coalesce(i.converted_invites, 0) / nullif(a.active_users, 0), 4)   as k_factor
from months as m
left join active as a on a.month = m.month
left join signups as s on s.month = m.month
left join invites as i on i.month = m.month

-- One row per school per day (zero-filled), including DAU and funds raised.
--
-- Incremental runs rebuild only the dates touched by the run: dates of purchase
-- or referral records re-evaluated in this run, and signup dates of users first
-- seen in the newest batch. Every school is written for each rebuilt date, so a
-- date whose activity drops to zero is overwritten rather than left stale.

with



dates as (
    select date_day
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_date"
    
),

activity as (
    select
        school_id,
        activity_date,
        count(*)                                  as active_users,
        count(*) filter (where purchases > 0)     as purchasing_users,
        sum(purchases)                            as purchases,
        sum(spend)                                as spend,
        sum(points_earned)                        as points_earned,
        sum(dollars_raised)                       as dollars_raised,
        sum(referrals_sent)                       as referrals_sent
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_user_activity_daily"
    where activity_date in (select date_day from dates)
    group by all
),

signups as (
    select school_id, signup_date, count(*) as new_users
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_users"
    where signup_date in (select date_day from dates)
    group by all
)

select
    d.date_day                           as activity_date,
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    coalesce(a.active_users, 0)          as active_users,
    coalesce(a.purchasing_users, 0)      as purchasing_users,
    coalesce(n.new_users, 0)             as new_users,
    coalesce(a.purchases, 0)             as purchases,
    coalesce(a.spend, 0)                 as spend,
    coalesce(a.points_earned, 0)         as points_earned,
    coalesce(a.dollars_raised, 0)        as dollars_raised,
    coalesce(a.referrals_sent, 0)        as referrals_sent
from dates as d
cross join "carton_caps"."gold"."dim_schools" as s
left join activity as a on a.school_id = s.school_id and a.activity_date = d.date_day
left join signups as n on n.school_id = s.school_id and n.signup_date = d.date_day
select * from "carton_caps"."gold"."cohort_retention" where not coalesce((retention_rate between 0 and 1), false)

select cohort_month, channel, months_since_signup, count(*) as n
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."cohort_retention"
    group by cohort_month, channel, months_since_signup
    having count(*) > 1

select month
from "carton_caps"."gold"."referral_growth_monthly"
where month is null

select

from "carton_caps"."gold"."referral_growth_monthly"

-- One row per school per month: MAU, average DAU, stickiness and funds raised.
with daily as (
    select
        school_id,
        school_name,
        cast(date_trunc('month', activity_date) as date) as month,
        avg(active_users)    as avg_dau,
        sum(new_users)       as new_users,
        sum(purchases)       as purchases,
        sum(spend)           as spend,
        sum(points_earned)   as points_earned,
        sum(dollars_raised)  as dollars_raised,
        sum(referrals_sent)  as referrals_sent
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_daily_activity"
    group by all
),

monthly_active as (
    select school_id, activity_month as month, count(distinct user_id) as mau
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_user_activity_daily"
    group by all
)

select
    d.month,
    d.school_id,
    d.school_name,
    coalesce(m.mau, 0)                                  as mau,
    round(d.avg_dau, 3)                                 as avg_dau,
    round(d.avg_dau / nullif(m.mau, 0), 4)              as stickiness,
    d.new_users,
    d.purchases,
    d.spend,
    d.points_earned,
    d.dollars_raised,
    sum(d.dollars_raised) over (partition by d.school_id order by d.month) as cumulative_dollars_raised,
    d.referrals_sent
from daily as d
left join monthly_active as m on m.school_id = d.school_id and m.month = d.month
select * from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_engagement_monthly" where not coalesce((stickiness is null or stickiness between 0 and 1), false)

-- Dollars raised must agree from silver through every gold layer that reports them.
with totals as (
    select 'silver valid purchases' as source,
           cast(round(sum(points_expected) / 100, 2) as decimal(18, 2)) as dollars
    from "carton_caps"."silver"."int_purchases_checked" where dq_status = 'valid'
    union all
    select 'fct_purchases', sum(dollars_raised) from "carton_caps"."gold"."fct_purchases"
    union all
    select 'school_daily_activity', sum(dollars_raised) from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_daily_activity"
    union all
    select 'school_engagement_monthly', sum(dollars_raised) from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_engagement_monthly"
    union all
    select 'product_category_monthly', sum(dollars_raised) from "carton_caps"."gold"."product_category_monthly"
    union all
    select 'spending_by_segment', sum(dollars_raised) from "carton_caps"."gold"."spending_by_segment"
)

select *
from totals
where abs(dollars - (select dollars from totals where source = 'fct_purchases')) > 0.01

    from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_engagement_monthly"
    group by month, school_id

-- School fundraising rankings by month, with movement and cumulative standing.
with ranked as (
    select
        month,
        school_id,
        school_name,
        dollars_raised,
        cumulative_dollars_raised,
        mau,
        rank() over (partition by month order by dollars_raised desc)            as monthly_rank,
        rank() over (partition by month order by cumulative_dollars_raised desc) as cumulative_rank,
        dollars_raised / nullif(sum(dollars_raised) over (partition by month), 0) as share_of_month
    from "carton_caps"."gold"."school_engagement_monthly"
)

select
    month,
    school_id,
    school_name,
    dollars_raised,
    monthly_rank,
    lag(monthly_rank) over (partition by school_id order by month)                  as previous_monthly_rank,
    lag(monthly_rank) over (partition by school_id order by month) - monthly_rank   as rank_change,
    cumulative_dollars_raised,
    cumulative_rank,
    round(dollars_raised / nullif(mau, 0), 2)                                       as dollars_per_active_user,
    round(share_of_month, 4)                                                        as share_of_month
from ranked
